issues.concern: The gloss is incomplete and misleading. It only covers the humble aspect of the word, but 参る also has a distinct meaning of 'to visit (a shrine/temple)' which is not humble.
issues.suggestion: to come; to go (humble); to visit (a shrine or temple)
